lines.2: Kinu and I were sprinting down the road to school.
lines.4: 「Pick up the pace! Think you can keep up with me?」
lines.9: The sweat on my forehead gleamed refreshingly.
lines.10: 「This means we're training our bodies too, right?」
lines.11: 「...Leo. That was quite the hectic entrance.」
lines.15: She grabbed me by the collar.
lines.17: Kinu was getting farther away... Damn it, she ran.
lines.22: 「At least fix your bedhead. People who can't keep themselves presentable get on my nerves!」
lines.23: 「Don't embarrass your big sister too much, all right?」
lines.24: 「Hmph. A bad character shows on the outside too, I guess.」
lines.25: Geh. I was trapped between them!
lines.26: Konoe on my right, Otome on my left.
lines.29: 「Listen properly when your senior is talking. That's only logical.」
lines.30: I shrank beneath a lecture from two beautiful women.
lines.31: 「You were sloppy back in middle school too.」
lines.34: 「Whoa. Getting lectured by two girls! What an awful picture.」
lines.35: 「And yet, why am I somehow jealous?」
lines.36: I needed an escape route... That's it!
